This Rmd file is to merge the counts from mm9 to our newly produced mm10 bed file

## Load the library and the data
```{r}
# load the tidyverse
library(tidyverse)

# load the TRIP data (mm9 txt file)
mm9 <- read_tsv("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/data/raw/mmc2.txt", skip = 1)

# load the liftovered mm10 data
mm10_bed <- read_tsv("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/data/processed/trip-mm10-short.bed", col_names = FALSE)
# add headers
colnames(mm10_bed) <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "pool_barcode", "score", "strand")
```

## Process `mm9` dataframe 

- Create a new column to `mm9`: "pool_barcode"
- Remove columns we don't want: `TRIP_pool`, `barcode`, `position`, `strand`, `chromosome`
```{r}
mm9 <- mm9 %>% 
  mutate(pool_barcode = paste0(TRIP_pool, "_", barcode)) %>% 
  select(pool_barcode, normalization_counts_1, normalization_counts_2, expression_counts_1, expression_counts_2)
```

## Merge `mm9` and `mm10_bed`

Now we can have the counts of TRIP with mm10 reference genome
```{r}
merged_mm10 <- mm10_bed %>% 
  left_join(mm9, by = "pool_barcode")
```

## Save as bedfile
```{r}
write_tsv(merged_mm10, "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/data/processed/trip-mm10-long.bed", col_names = FALSE)
```
